scoring_justification: Full T1 recompute infeasible: agent writes only final computed critical parameters to results.json with no intermediate raw trace (no per-beta F(w) evaluations, no root tables). The verifier sandbox cannot re-run the numerical root-finding over parameter sweeps needed to recompute these values independently. T0 result-level compare against paper-reported reference values with tolerances per D4.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference critical parameter values from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures: Eq.(15a) gives β_c JK = 4 for γ=0; paper text/Fig.2 reports β₁ JK = 3.5330 and β₂ JK = 3.6475 for γ=0.0003, K=7000; paper text states γ_c ≈ 0.0002 for K=7000.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted verbatim from paper's published numerical results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual published values, verified against the reference solve.sh which reproduces them exactly.

outputs.description: Computed critical parameters characterizing the superconducting phase transition in the q-deformed strong-coupling model.

output_contract.notes: The values are specific to the maximum-term approximation of the grand partition function with K=7000 and the specified deformation parameters. All outputs are deterministic from the model equations.
